seo.title: Privacy Policy
seo.description: How {{brand.name}} collects, uses, and stores personal data.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.description: Plain English, no dark patterns. Last updated {{legal.privacy.lastUpdated}}.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: When you submit the contact or booking form we collect your name, email address, company name, and whatever you write in the message field. That's it — we don't ask for anything we don't need to reply to you.
We collect aggregate, cookieless analytics about page visits (page path, referrer, country, device class). This data is not tied to an individual and never leaves our own infrastructure.

sections.heading: Why we collect it
body: To reply to your enquiry, schedule a meeting you requested, and keep a record of the conversation for as long as it's commercially relevant.
To understand which pages are useful so we can improve them. Nothing more.

sections.heading: What we don't do
body: We don't sell, rent, or share your data with third parties for marketing. We don't add you to a mailing list or an automated sequence because you filled in a form.
We don't use third-party advertising trackers, and we don't set cookies for advertising purposes.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: Enquiry data is retained for 24 months from the last contact, then deleted. Contractual records are kept for the period required by UK company and tax law.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You can ask us for a copy of the data we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email {{brand.email}} and we'll action the request within 30 days.
If you're in the UK or EEA you also have the right to complain to your local data protection authority.

sections.heading: Sub-processors
body: We use a small number of third-party services to run this site and our business: cloud hosting, transactional email, and a video conferencing provider for scheduled calls. Each is contractually bound to process data only on our instructions.

seo.title: Terms of Service
seo.description: The terms covering use of the {{brand.name}} website and lab products.

hero.title: Terms of Service
hero.description: Short, readable, and not a substitute for the contract we'd actually sign. Last updated {{legal.terms.lastUpdated}}.

sections.heading: Using this site
body: You're welcome to read, quote, and link to anything on this site. Please don't scrape it at a volume that affects other visitors, and don't republish whole pages as your own.

sections.heading: Engagement terms
body: Nothing on this site constitutes a binding offer. Client engagements are governed by a separate master services agreement and statement of work signed by both parties.
Prices shown are indicative, exclude VAT and applicable taxes, and may change. The price in your signed statement of work is the one that applies.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
body: Work product created for a client under a statement of work transfers to that client on payment, as set out in the agreement.
The {{brand.name}} name, logo, and the source code of our own products remain ours. Product use is governed by the licence accompanying each product.

sections.heading: Product availability
body: Products marked Beta, Alpha, or Research are provided as-is and may change or be withdrawn. Uptime commitments apply only to plans that state them explicitly.

sections.heading: Liability
body: To the extent permitted by law, we're not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from use of this site. Liability under a client engagement is capped as set out in the relevant agreement.

sections.heading: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales, and the courts of England and Wales have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute.
